d: Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as head of the company, citing the US government’s input and saying his reinstatement is in the best interests of stockholders, employees, partners and customers. Huang’s return follows weeks of turmoil at Nvidia after he was pushed out over revelations of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a subordinate and another with a woman the US government has investigated for spying on behalf of China. Ed Ludlow, Bloomberg Tech Host break down the return of Jensen Huang to Nvidia. Mary Ann Bartels, Chief Investment Strategist at Sanctuary Wealth…
